one_liner: Customizable 3D neon sign with audio playback, supporting text, spacing, scale, color, alignment, and visibility toggles.
primary_use_case: Create and display dynamic neon text signage in a Hyperfy world, optionally with background music or sound effects.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided MP4 preview (m3_NEON.mp4) to showcase the neon sign with and audio playback; the media is a fallback for any author.
